d0f9cb64-8f61-4a8a-8a2c-a0dddabab10d.name: retail_order_exchange_and_change_workflow
d0f9cb64-8f61-4a8a-8a2c-a0dddabab10d.description: Handles retail order exchanges, option changes, pending-order item modifications (including cancellations/removals), shipping-address changes, and variant-availability questions end-to-end with identity fallback, order-status policy gating, exact and description-based variant matching, explicit confirmation, safe writes/recovery, gift-card/shipping policy clarification, human escalation, and a policy-gated new-order fallback when an order cannot be modified.
d0f9cb64-8f61-4a8a-8a2c-a0dddabab10d.identity_desc_norm: handles retail order exchanges option changes pending order item modifications including cancellations removals shipping address changes and variant availability questions end to end with identity fallback order status policy gating exact and description based variant matching explicit confirmation safe writes recovery gift card shipping policy clarification human escalation and a policy gated new order fallback when an order cannot be modified

30d538b0-6b0f-43b6-b466-fdd93a8b5e2e.name: retail_order_support_orchestration
30d538b0-6b0f-43b6-b466-fdd93a8b5e2e.description: Processes retail returns/refunds, exchanges, cancellations/reversals, item/address/default-address modifications, tracking, payment/pending-order issues, compound multi-intent requests, order-change/remove-item without an order ID, and cheapest-item-under-budget exchange/return qualification. Resolves identity via layered fallback, verifies orders/items and refund destinations, executes writes one at a time, validates tool results, and escalates safely.
30d538b0-6b0f-43b6-b466-fdd93a8b5e2e.identity_desc_norm: processes retail returns refunds exchanges cancellations reversals item address default address modifications tracking payment pending order issues compound multi intent requests order change remove item without an order id and cheapest item under budget exchange return qualification resolves identity via layered fallback verifies orders items and refund destinations executes writes one at a time validates tool results and escalates safely

8a68ecd2-85c7-4e12-ad46-9022129adfad.name: retail_product_order_orchestration
8a68ecd2-85c7-4e12-ad46-9022129adfad.description: Guide a retail customer-service agent to verify identity/profile data, search the catalog, confirm product variants, verify or update shipping addresses, look up existing orders (including resolving an unspecified order from user ID plus a distinguishing attribute), place/return orders, and report items/payment using real tool outputs. Trigger when a user asks about product availability, variant details, address changes, order lookup, payment history, or purchase/return completion.
